meaning: 醫療、牙科和眼部保健（的保險）。

phrase: We also include 401k and match up the employee contributions up to 3% and life insurance.
meaning: 我們有福利，並且提供跟員工自付401k額同等金額的付出到至多3%。

phrase: Bonuses are based on how profitable the company was as well as based on the employee performance.
meaning: 獎金是根據公司盈利情況和員工表現發放的。

phrase: A full list of all the insurance options
meaning: 所有保險選項的完整清單。

phrase: The company provides professional development opportunities.
meaning: 公司有提供專業進修的機會。

phrase: Every Tuesday, we have Lunch and Learn.
meaning: 每週二，我們會舉辦「午餐與學習」的活動。

phrase: An outside presenter or a consultant visits our office to share about the latest industry trends.
meaning: 外部講師或顧問會來辦公室分享最新的行業趨勢。

phrase: Occasionally, we send key employees to conferences and tradeshows.
meaning: 有時候，我們也會不定期派遣重要員工參加研討會或展覽。

phrase: Everything sounds good to me.
meaning: 一切在我聽起來都很不錯。

phrase: We will be in touch through email.
meaning: 我們會通過電子郵件與您聯繫。

phrase: Good to see you!
meaning: 很高興見到你！

phrase: How’s your weekend?
meaning: 你的週末過得怎麼樣？

phrase: It’s been alright!
meaning: 還不錯！

phrase: Can you believe how cold/ hot it is outside today?
meaning: 你敢相信今天外面有多冷/多熱嗎？

phrase: I’m a little under the weather.
meaning: 我有點小感冒/不舒服。

phrase: I’ve been staying in over the weekend.
meaning: 我週末都待在家裡。

phrase: Oh, I’m sorry to hear that.
meaning: 哇，我很遺憾聽到這個消息。

phrase: Did you do anything fun with your kids?
meaning: 你有跟孩子們做什麼有趣的事嗎？

phrase: A pumpkin patch.
meaning: 一個南瓜田/南瓜園

phrase: They were not behaving well.
meaning: 他們不太聽話/不太乖。

phrase: You’re doing your best.
meaning: 你已經盡力了。

phrase: I can’t imagine having to keep two little humans with infinite energy quiet.
meaning: 我無法想像要讓兩個精力無限的小傢伙安靜下來。

phrase: Did you catch the Dodgers game last night?
meaning: 你昨晚有看道奇隊的比賽嗎？

phrase: I’m not a big baseball fan.
meaning: 我不算是棒球迷。

phrase: I saw online that they’re making it to the championship!
meaning: 我看到網上說他們進入總冠軍賽了！

phrase: Any vacation plans coming up for Christmas?
meaning: 你聖誕節有什麼休假期間的計畫嗎？

phrase: I’m saving my vacation days.
meaning: 我正在累積可休假天數。

phrase: How’s your family/kids/wife/husband?
meaning: 你的家人/孩子/太太/丈夫都還好嗎？

phrase: They’re doing well.
meaning: 他們都很好。

phrase: At least from what they told me.
meaning: 至少他們是這樣說的。

phrase: Parenting is a blessing even if at times it’s chaotic.
meaning: 養育孩子是一個祝福，即使有時候會很混亂。

phrase: I should’ve just gotten another dog.
meaning: 當初早知道我應該再養一隻狗的。

phrase: That’s... something.
meaning: 這…還真是特別。（帶有驚訝或不確定的語氣）

phrase: Don’t get me wrong!
meaning: 不過別誤會！

phrase: They don’t talk back to me.
meaning: 他們不會跟我頂嘴。

phrase: Call me at work.
meaning: 在上班時打給我。

phrase: Just to ask where I put their cereals or Lunchables.
meaning: 只是為了問我麥片或午餐點心放在哪裡。

phrase: Before you know it, they’ll be all grown up and out of the house.
meaning: 轉眼之間，他們就長大然後搬出家裡了。

phrase: Clearly you’ve never had an adult kid ask for money.
meaning: 顯然你從來沒有遇過成年的小孩跟你要錢。

phrase: I suppose not.
meaning: 我想應該沒有。

phrase: Enjoy it while you can.
meaning: 趁還能享受的時候好好享受吧！

phrase: No kids, no stress.
meaning: 沒有小孩，沒有壓力。（通常用來開玩笑）

phrase: Oh, come on.
meaning: 噢，別這樣啦！（表示不相信、抱怨或催促）

phrase: Stuck at home.
meaning: 困在家裡。（指無法出門，像是生病、疫情期間）

phrase: Don’t mind me.
meaning: 別管我/別在意我。

phrase: See you later!
meaning: 等會見下次見！/

phrase: Just a little down in the dumps.
meaning: 只是有點情緒低落/心情沮喪。

phrase: I do it to myself.
meaning: 這是我自找的。

phrase: The job market will be so bad that we will be lucky to get poverty wages at best!
meaning: 就業市場會糟到一個程度是能拿到微薄工資就已經算幸運的了。

phrase: Prices have been skyrocketing.
meaning: 物價一直飆升。

phrase: It used to cost 20 dollars to fill up.
meaning: 以前加滿油箱只要20美元。

phrase: I was looking at the polls.
meaning: 我剛剛在看民調/調查問卷。

phrase: It will have a negative impact on the economy.
meaning: 這會對經濟產生負面影響。

phrase: I have been feeling so run down.
meaning: 我最近感到疲憊不堪/精疲力竭。

phrase: We have spoken about this.
meaning: 我們之前已經討論過這件事了。

phrase: Most of it is not even objective news reporting.
meaning: 大多數根本不是客觀的新聞報導。

phrase: It’s just sensationalism.
meaning: 只是煽情主義的聳動報導。

phrase: But one thing led to another.
meaning: 但是一件事接著一件事。

phrase: The forecast said the weather’s gonna be good.
meaning: 天氣預報說天氣會不錯喔。

phrase: Climate change forecast, financial forecast, election forecast.
meaning: 氣候變遷預測、財經預測、選舉預測

phrase: Shame on you!
meaning: 怎麼這樣呢？/你太丟臉了/你應該感到羞恥！

phrase: You are only bringing yourself down.
meaning: 你只是讓自己心情低落。

phrase: Look at the housing market.
meaning: 你看看房地產市場。

phrase: Caught red-handed.
meaning: 當場被抓包（做壞事或尷尬行為的時候）

phrase: Tell you what.
meaning: 這樣吧！（用來引出建議或提議）

phrase: It is already behind me.
meaning: 我已經拋諸腦後了！（表示不再在意過去的事情）

phrase: What has brought this on?
meaning: 怎麼突然這麼說？

phrase: I am feeling gloomy.
meaning: 我心情很低落。

phrase: I just lay back.
meaning: 我就放鬆休息。

phrase: Pretend I am a kid and have not a worry in the world.
meaning: 假裝自己還是個孩子，沒有任何一點煩惱。

phrase: When I was a young girl, those movies were my world.
meaning: 當我還是小女孩時，那些電影曾經是我的全世界（形容某事物對自己極其重要）。

phrase: This program contains disrespectful depictions of culture.
meaning: 本節目包含對文化不尊重的描繪。

phrase: We want the audience to also recognize the negative impact of these opinions.
meaning: 我們希望觀眾能夠理解到這些觀點的負面影響。

phrase: This message is added for kid movies that show stereotypes of people.
meaning: 這種警告是針對某些對特定群體有刻板印象的兒童電影加上的。

phrase: Isn’t that a little bit over the top?
meaning: 這是不是有點太誇張了？

phrase: It takes me away from everything.
meaning: 它讓我暫時逃離所有事情（現實、壓力等）。

phrase: Where is the fun in that?
meaning: 這樣有什麼好玩的？

phrase: I think children are too young to understand such concepts.
meaning: 孩子們根本太小，無法理解這些概念。

phrase: The very term "being politically correct" started in America.
meaning: 「政治正確」這個概念本來就是從美國開始的。

phrase: I didn’t know that was a thing.
meaning: 我不知道這居然是一回事。

phrase: The world is hiding its head in the sand.
meaning: 世界卻選擇視而不見、把頭埋在沙裡（指忽略或拒絕思考不愉快的事情）。
